title: Welcome to Mogul Workspace
text: Welcome to Mogul Workspace, the new web tool for preparing quotations at Mogul Electromech. In the next few minutes, we'll go through everything: the home screen, making a quote from a customer's enquiry, printing and emailing it, revisions, the quotation list, customers, and settings.

title: Home
text: This is the Home screen. At the top you see the total quoted before VAT, the number of quotes issued, and how many customers were quoted. Use the buttons on the right to switch between one week, four weeks, three months, or twelve months.

title: Home
text: Below that, the bars show which customers and which salesmen quoted the most. And the Largest quotes table lists the biggest ones. Click any quote number to open it.

title: Finding your way
text: On the left is the menu. Home, Quotations, Customers, and Settings. The red New quote button is always there at the top. Let's make a new quote now.

title: Step 1 · Customer
text: Step one: the customer. Start typing the name, and the list filters as you type. Pick the customer, and their address, payment terms, validity, delivery and VAT terms are filled in automatically. Fields marked 'from customer' came from the customer's saved details. You can still change them for this quote.

title: New customer
text: If the customer is new, just type the name and choose 'New customer' at the bottom of the list. You fill in their details once, and they are saved for next time.

title: Steps 2 & 3 · Enquiry and salesman
text: Step two is the enquiry reference, and step three is the salesman. The app remembers the last salesman you used. The date is today by default, and you can type the kind attention name here.

title: Step 4 · Paste items
text: Step four is the best part. You don't need to type the items. In the customer's Excel sheet, select the rows and copy them. Then come back to the quote and press Control V, anywhere on the page.

title: Paste preview
text: A preview opens. The app found the header row, and mapped each column: description, quantity and unit. Part numbers and make are added to the description. Section headings are kept. It even spotted the enquiry number, and offers to fill it in. If a column is mapped wrong, change it here. When it looks right, press Enter, or click Add lines.

title: Paste from email too
text: The same works for a numbered list copied from an email, or you can import an Excel or CSV file with this button, or drop the file on the grid. Prices in the customer's sheet are ignored. Rates are always entered by you.

title: Step 5 · Enter rates
text: Step five: enter the rates. The cursor is already in the first rate. Type the rate and press Enter, and you move down to the next one. The amount and the totals on the right update as you go. If any line has no rate, you'll see a warning here.

title: Editing lines
text: Each line has a menu on the right. You can insert a line or a heading, duplicate, move, or delete. You can also drag lines by the handle on the left to reorder them. Control D copies the cell above, and if you make a mistake after a paste, Control Z or the Undo button takes it back.

title: Remarks and internal notes
text: Remarks are printed on the quote. Internal notes are only for us, and are never printed.

title: Save
text: Now save, with the Save button or Control S. The quote gets its number on the first save, for example M E, twenty-six, zero zero seven. The app warns you if you try to leave with unsaved changes.

title: Workings
text: On the right is Workings. Attach photos of your calculations, supplier price lists, or screenshots. On a phone, tap it to use the camera. Workings are internal, and never printed.

title: Print / Save as PDF
text: Click Print, or Save as PDF. You see the quote exactly as the customer will, on the Mogul letterhead, with the T R N, the stamp, and the amount in words. Click the Print button, then choose Save as PDF. The file is already named with the quote number and the customer's name.

title: Email via Outlook
text: To send it, click Email via Outlook. The email address, copy, subject and message are filled in from the salesman's template. Click Open in Outlook, attach the PDF you saved, and send. The email is logged on the quote, so everyone can see it was sent.

title: Revisions
text: If the customer asks for changes after you've sent the quote, click Revise. This creates REV zero one, with the same number. The old version is kept read-only for the record, and the Revisions box lets you move between them.

title: Duplicate, cancel, delete
text: Duplicate copies the quote into a new one with a new number. That's handy for repeat orders. Cancel quote keeps it in the list but leaves it out of the Home totals. And a draft that was never printed or sent can be deleted with the bin icon.

title: Quotations list
text: The Quotations page lists every quote. Search by number, customer, enquiry reference, or even item text. Filter by salesman, status, or date. Tick 'Show replaced revisions' to see older versions too. And Export CSV gives you the list in Excel.

title: Customers
text: Under Customers, you see everyone we quote, with their default terms and how many quotes they've had. Click a customer to edit their details. The terms you set here are copied onto every new quote for that customer. You can also import a full customer list from Excel or CSV.

title: Settings
text: Settings holds the company letterhead details, the quote number prefix, VAT, currency, and the default terms for new customers. Below that are the salesmen. Click a salesman to set their email address and their own email template.

title: That's it!
text: That's everything. To recap: pick the customer, paste the items, enter the rates, save, then print and email. Thank you, and happy quoting!
